capture.what: GET /api/v1/activities?limit=50, and with filter=token, object, identity and dao, answered by the lists lane P3 third-read API build (574cb27d, after the item resolver of 0ab62b48) in process over the live mainnet stores (no server, no node reader), with itemTypes
capture.token: the token feed from its 22nd row: its first 21 rows are Force Bridge transactions of more than 100 parties each (8 MB), not kept
capture.shape: converted on 2026-11-20 to the shape the route sends since lane feed (ruling 14 of gate P), by the route's rules from the captured parties, which were every party: participantCount, partyIds (each party by the first 20 bytes of its lock hash, with its tags), feePayer, each item's movement, and participants the parties a row draws; converted again the same day to part 4's shape: items stated once from every party (movement, movers, a token's amount), and participants the five largest CKB changes and the fee payer alone
